about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Professional Profile
about.lead: I work where operations, technology, and strategy meet — bridging teams, building the tools they need, and clearing away the repetitive work that quietly slows a business down.
about.p1: I build applications that help people do their work with less friction — automating data requests with Python, moving reporting out of fragile spreadsheets and into systems teams actually enjoy using, and turning repetitive manual processes into reliable tools. Whether I'm coordinating tree-planting programmes across Indonesia or shipping an Android app, the aim stays the same: something measurable, useful, and built to last.
about.p2: Working alongside startups, international NGOs, and government institutions has taught me to adapt quickly and communicate across cultures — and convinced me that the best outcomes come from pairing real domain knowledge with the right technology. I'm open to new roles and collaborations, and I'd be glad to talk.
experience.title: Experience
experience.subtitle: My Professional Journey
exp.0.desc: Manage TREEO customer success end-to-end: field visits to understand partner needs, using data-analysis tools to turn field and platform data into data-driven decisions, refining the apps UI/UX, and preparing relevant training and documentation for partners.
exp.1.desc: Ran daily operations across five Tree Planting Partners — planning and monitoring planting programs, acting as the single point of contact for each partner, and safeguarding data quality and reporting — while owning customer success in the field: assessing TREEO user experience, monitoring daily system activity, and refining the app's UI/UX.
exp.2.desc:
Assessed and evaluated TREEO user experience in the field.
Monitored daily system activity on the cloud platform.
Contributed to the improvement and development of the app UI/UX.
Provided direct technical support and training to users.
exp.3.desc: Designed and shipped Android applications with Kotlin and Java in Android Studio. Created wireframes and high-fidelity mockups for mobile and web platforms, and collaborated closely with stakeholders to translate business requirements into intuitive interfaces.
exp.4.desc: Prepared data flows and safety materials, managed the data collection and processing process, and ensured new safety procedures were consistently applied across all team members.
exp.5.desc: Managed all office operations, covering contract administration, asset handovers, coordination of security and driver teams, maintenance of the operational vehicle fleet, and inventorying all company assets.
exp.6.desc: Managed end-to-end B2B communication and demonstrated the Quick Tractor product for oil palm plantations across Sumatra, Sulawesi, and Kalimantan.
exp.7.desc: Designed the cover for the annual census publication and created visual assets such as posters and vector graphics to support the launch activities.
